Book My First Home Game Plan

A free 20-minute planning call with Evan Karwowski.

What you’ll leave with

  1. A starting point that fits you. We’ll look at what you’ve already done, whether that’s saving homes, comparing towns, or talking with a lender.
  2. Up to three next actions, in order. For each one, we’ll name who can help and decide what to do first.
  3. A written recap. I’ll email your plan within two business days after our call so you have it handy.

The First Home Next Steps Sheet

Start on the page that matches your question. Page two helps you ask a lender for a payment and cash estimate. Page three narrows down which homes are worth touring. On page four, put a date beside your next action.

You can use the sheet on your own. A call is optional.

Before you book

Can I book if I’m still exploring?

Yes. You might be a year out or deciding whether buying makes sense at all. We can start there.

Do I need to speak with a lender first?

No. We can work out which questions to ask. A lender handles preapproval, loan terms, and estimates specific to your finances.

What if I already have an agent?

Tell me when you book so we can respect any existing agreement and clarify what we can discuss.

Does the free call commit me to working with you?

No. If you want help with a home search afterward, we’ll discuss services, representation, and negotiable fees separately.
